findings.evidence: analyze.save uses direct write_bytes for deterministic final reports; existing corrupt bytes cause rejection rather than acceptance.
findings.resolution: Accepted for bounded stateless cheap cached algebra with zero model calls. No completed native measurement can be lost or falsely accepted. Incomplete output requires explicit preservation and a fresh output version; do not claim robust crash resume from these fixtures.

limitations: Only measured FIT full/dose1/so condition, 64 blocks128 documents. No causal/native/readout claim or B-MASK approval. Checked historical JumpReLU/feature_arms conventions and top score formula, code, protocol,790input manifest and all799snapshot hashes. Independent synthetic audit recomputes counts/norm/W1 for selected groups and verifies OFF contribution, deterministic matching, unique/disjoint32 groups and changed-result rejection. No actual FIT matching or model evaluation executed during review. Heuristic does not establish global infeasibility; count support bound is separate. FIT heterogeneity tolerances are descriptive marginal distribution bands, not equivalence proof or joint/per-context balance.
